Spider_Tiny_Underdark
Lur Jox is a spider in Grymforge during Act One. It can be found near the cages west of the waypoint with several other spiders and  Murmath.
“
We need no 'Lolth' - no spider queen! Father Murmath is the head of clan Lur. He hatched us, raised us, feeds us!
„
— Lur Jox

Involvement

Act One

If approaching, the party can use  Speak with Animals to listen to the conversation between  Lur Xanta and the other spiders. Xanta is trying to convince the other spiders to leave  Murmath and join the cult of Lolth. Depending on dialogue choices, Jox can attack Xanta, or Jox can be convinced to join the cult.
